pending.message: Specific WQ10 release-RED hypothesis from read-only source audit: all three failing test fixtures (`Client.Tests/WorkQueueCanonicalMigrationPrepareTests.fs:66`, `WorkQueueMultiLedgerPreparedRecoveryTests.fs:167`, `WorkQueueProjectMigrationPrepareTests.fs:57`) call `Directory.CreateDirectory root` without `SetUnixFileMode`; security guards reject GroupWrite/OtherWrite root (`Client/Modules/WorkQueueCanonicalMigrationPrepare.fs:245-248`, `WorkQueueProjectMigrationPrepare.fs:133-138`, `AccountCapacityLedger.fs:815-822`). Under inherited umask 0002/0000, roots get 0775/0777, so positive disposable-fixture authorization fails and subsequent assertions cascade. Crucial: inspect real failing fixture's Unix mode/umask in isolated source-exact narrow diagnostic (not another full suite), show negative 0775 and positive explicit 0700 with unchanged security code. Do not weaken fail-closed guards; assess other errors separately; scope any repair to fixture setup, independently review. No full Client rerun/main/cutover.
